ground_stack_mount.role: Ground-stack insert mounting annulus, rooted across its entire X run in the east flank and supported by the full-width ground-stack ceiling column.
ground_stack_mount.print_direction: ceiling down; flat D chord and ceiling column print first; the retained curved annulus closes last
ground_stack_mount.terminal_role: The round outer half closes the insert annulus; it is a curved mounting-boss terminal, not a separate flat fin or a new thin rail.

keystone_receptacle.role: Rear RiteAV jack receptacle: standard-size face/body aperture, swing-entry bevel and two complete rooted retaining catches.
keystone_receptacle.terminal_role: The two witnesses lie on the swing-entry bevel as its outer strip closes onto the rear show plane; neither lies on a retaining catch or the full-section aperture surround.

scope: Native canonical stock, functional load/fit roles and complete host connectivity. Actual emitted-path envelopes are recorded separately; printed fit, insert retention, cable retention, removal force and lifetime are unmeasured.
